purpose: Replicate the surviving native-BitNet A4 residual shape-gain result on substantially more frozen tokens and a second corpus without reopening the failed sub-4-bit lane.

calibration.policy: one WikiText validation calibration is frozen and transferred unchanged to both evaluation corpora

representation.radial_calibration: cascaded on the frozen WikiText validation calibration set

conditions: fixed angular A4 + cascaded 4-bit log-radius with token radius circularly shifted within sequence

primary_rules.replication_per_corpus: log4-radius A4 NLL < matched dynamic-A4 NLL and paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound for delta(log4-dynamic) < 0
primary_rules.robust_replication_pass: all three per-corpus rules pass on both corpora
primary_rules.partial_replication: primary replication passes on only one corpus or hostile controls are mixed
primary_rules.stop: if primary replication fails on both corpora, park the A4 claim pending redesign

prohibitions: Do not reopen A3/A2/A1 in Gate006.
Do not tune thresholds after seeing evaluation results.
Do not infer kernel speed or energy savings from this functional Transformers experiment.
